g1-implement.title: Stop-hook precedence + crew-dispatch.md doctrine: implement
g1-implement.imperative: Fill templates/IMPLEMENTER_HANDOFF.template.md for this gate: task is (1) edit scripts/hooks/spine_rail.py's `_mid_flight_reason` (and `_owning_session_reason` if warranted) to explicitly state the Stop hook is authoritative over the context-trip advisory, and to point an agent that must honestly exit mid-gate at the engine's `spine_halt block` verb (with a reason), never at ending the turn; (2) edit skills/commander/references/crew-dispatch.md to state the same precedence (Stop hook wins; the context-trip advisory is non-binding guidance subordinate to it; the sanctioned mid-run exit is `spine_halt block`) in a place a Commander reads before dispatching/waiting on a crew. Constraints: do NOT touch scripts/checklist_engine.py or scripts/mcp_spine_server.py (Lane A fence -- if the task seems to require it, stop and report a blocker instead); do NOT change WHEN the Stop hook fires, only what it says; keep the two other Stop-hook reason strings (`_owning_session_reason`, the lease-still-active branch) internally consistent with the new wording; follow constellation-how-to-talk (clear, concise, grounded, one name per thing). Net-deletion: the rewritten mid-flight reason should not simply grow -- trim any now-redundant clause it supersedes. Dispatch a subagent invoking constellation-implementer with the completed handoff. Wait for and integrate the returned IMPLEMENTER_RESULT: attach g1-implement --type implementer-result --field status=<value> (lowercase, verbatim from Return status).

g1-integrate.imperative: Check the REVIEW_RESULT verdict.
